paragraphs.section: Nonlinear Model Predictive Control of Flexible Ammonia Production
english_fragments: April 3, 2024

Flexible dynamic operation of ammonia synthesis is a key enabling factor of green ammonia production in the face of intermittency in renewable energy sources. A nonlinear model predictive control scheme is presented in this paper for the Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis process with a varying feed flowrate. The considered process consists of three interstage-cooled reactor beds and a flash separator, with a flexible reactor load varying between 50% and 100% of its nominal capacity. The proposed control scheme aims to control the reactor temperatures, separation pressure, and the liquid volume in the flash tank during feed transitions. A simulation study is performed given an assumed 5-hour feed schedule. The results indicate that all controlled variables are maintained in a safe operating range and tracked with small offsets in the nominal case as well as under disturbances in the reaction rate. It takes approximately 10 minutes for the reactor temperatures and 40 minutes for the separation pressure to reach steady state after a large step change in the reactor load. In the comparison with a PID control scheme, the investigated NMPC scheme tracks feed temperatures and the separation pressure significantly faster with less oscillations. This study therefore demonstrates the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control scheme in enabling flexible operation of the process.
chinese_fragments: 面对可再生能源的间歇性，合成氨过程的柔性动态运行是实现绿氨生产的关键因素。本文针对进料流量变化的 Haber-Bosch 合成氨过程，提出了一种非线性模型预测控制方案。所研究的过程由三个采用级间冷却的反应器床层和一个闪蒸分离器组成，反应器负荷可在其额定处理能力的 50% 至 100% 之间灵活变化。所提出的控制方案旨在进料切换过程中控制反应器温度、分离压力以及闪蒸罐内的液体体积。基于假定的 5 小时进料调度，开展了仿真研究。结果表明，在标称工况下以及反应速率受到扰动时，所有被控变量均保持在安全操作范围内，并以较小的偏差实现跟踪。反应器负荷发生较大阶跃变化后，反应器温度和分离压力达到稳态分别需要约 10 分钟和 40 分钟。与 PID 控制方案相比，所研究的 NMPC 方案对进料温度和分离压力的跟踪明显更快，振荡也更少。因此，本研究证明了所提出的控制方案在实现该过程柔性运行方面的可行性与有效性。

english_fragments: Ammonia, a crucial chemical substance, is the second most produced chemical globally with an annual production amount of 176 million tons (David et al., 2020). Approximately 88% of ammonia produced is used as a fertilizer in agriculture, underscoring its significant role in this sector (Pattabathula and Richardson, 2016). Virtually all ammonia is synthesized through the Haber-Bosch process, in which nitrogen is converted to ammonia through a reaction with hydrogen at a temperature of 300-500 °C and a pressure around 200 bar (Erisman et al., 2008).
chinese_fragments: 氨是一种重要的化学物质，也是全球产量第二大的化学品，年产量为 1.76 亿吨（David et al., 2020）。约 88% 的氨用作农业肥料，凸显了其在农业领域的重要作用（Pattabathula and Richardson, 2016）。几乎所有的氨都通过 Haber-Bosch 工艺合成；在该工艺中，氮气在 300-500 °C、约 200 bar 的条件下与氢气反应，转化为氨（Erisman et al., 2008）。

english_fragments: Ammonia production currently relies heavily on fossil fuels. Specifically, over 90% of hydrogen used in ammonia production is sourced from natural gas reforming or coal gasification (Pattabathula and Richardson, 2016), contributing to around 2% of global CO₂ emissions (Smith and Torrente-Murciano, 2023). Replacing this hydrogen with one produced via water electrolysis powered by renewable energy sources (RES) will be a key step towards decarbonizing agriculture. Ammonia produced using such renewable hydrogen is referred to as green ammonia, and its production and utilization are attracting worldwide attention currently by industry, private investors, and academia (Wang et al., 2022). In addition to its role in decarbonizing agriculture, green ammonia has tremendous potential as a medium for storing renewable energy. Chemical-based energy storage (compared to batteries and mechanical energy storage systems) is a promising way to resolve large mismatches between the supply and demand of renewable power and enable long duration storage and high storage capacity. Candidate chemicals for use as storage media include hydrogen, ammonia, methanol, and methane (Palys and Daoutidis, 2022). Ammonia has three times higher energy density than hydrogen and costs 10-100 times less to store than hydrogen (Salmon and Bañares-Alcántara, 2021). In addition, it is a carbon-free fuel. Due to these advantages, green ammonia has been proposed as an energy vector for many renewable energy systems (Du et al., 2022), such as sustainable agricultural systems (Palys et al., 2021), power distribution systems (Riley et al., 2023), microgrids (Kong et al., 2024), and energy hubs (Ghappani and Karimi, 2023).
chinese_fragments: 目前，氨生产高度依赖化石燃料。具体而言，氨生产所用氢气中超过 90% 来自天然气重整或煤气化（Pattabathula and Richardson, 2016），由此产生的排放约占全球 CO₂ 排放量的 2%（Smith and Torrente-Murciano, 2023）。以利用可再生能源（RES）供电的水电解制氢替代上述氢气，将是推动农业脱碳的关键一步。利用这种可再生氢生产的氨称为绿氨，其生产与利用目前正受到全球工业界、私人投资者和学术界的关注（Wang et al., 2022）。除了有助于农业脱碳外，绿氨作为可再生能源储存介质也具有巨大潜力。与电池和机械储能系统相比，基于化学品的储能是一种有望解决可再生电力供需严重不匹配、并实现长时大容量储能的途径。可用作储能介质的候选化学品包括氢、氨、甲醇和甲烷（Palys and Daoutidis, 2022）。氨的能量密度为氢的三倍，而储存成本为氢的 1/10 至 1/100（Salmon and Bañares-Alcántara, 2021）。此外，氨是一种无碳燃料。由于这些优势，绿氨已被提出用作多种可再生能源系统的能源载体（Du et al., 2022），例如可持续农业系统（Palys et al., 2021）、配电系统（Riley et al., 2023）、微电网（Kong et al., 2024）以及能源枢纽（Ghappani and Karimi, 2023）。

english_fragments: Green ammonia production is likely to be powered by stand-alone renewable energy systems to ensure low carbon intensity in the electricity used. It will therefore be constrained by the availability of renewable power and consequently by the available inventory of hydrogen and nitrogen. Due to the intermittency of renewable power resources, ammonia production at a constant rate requires batteries and storage tanks to buffer fluctuations in the power supply and the feedstocks of hydrogen and nitrogen. Flexible ammonia production on the other hand, which largely follows the availability of RES, lends itself to significantly lower storage needs for hydrogen and/or power. An economic comparison between these two paradigms indicates that flexible operation leads to a significant reduction in the levelized cost of ammonia production (Palys and Daoutidis, 2023a) and is thus crucial for the economic viability of green ammonia production.
chinese_fragments: 绿氨生产很可能由独立式可再生能源系统供电，以确保所用电力具有较低的碳强度。因此，绿氨生产将受到可再生电力可用性的限制，并进而受到可用氢气和氮气库存的限制。由于可再生电力资源具有间歇性，以恒定速率生产氨需要配置电池和储罐，以缓冲电力供应及氢、氮原料供应的波动。另一方面，柔性合成氨生产主要随 RES 的可用情况调整，因此可以显著降低对储氢和/或储电的需求。对这两种模式的经济性比较表明，柔性运行能够显著降低氨生产的平准化成本（Palys and Daoutidis, 2023a），因而对绿氨生产的经济可行性至关重要。

english_fragments: Flexible operation of air separation processes for nitrogen production has been well documented (Klein et al., 2021). Proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzers also have a wide operating range (5% - 100% of the nominal capacity) with short response times (Boynuegri and Tekgun, 2023; Mucci et al., 2023), thus allowing for flexible production of hydrogen. The Haber-Bosch process however is operated at steady state in conventional plants, with only limited ramp-down capabilities from its nominal capacity (Fahr et al., 2023). Motivated by the need for flexible operation for green ammonia production, major ammonia technology companies have recently documented capabilities for dynamic operation over a wide operating range enabled by process control advancements. Casale has reported operation of ammonia synthesis plants at as low as 10% of their nominal capacities (Ostuni and Zardi, 2016) with ramping in the 10-100% range in the order of 30 minutes. Topsoe’s dynamic ammonia production technology features a load range of 10-100% and a ramp rate of at least 3% per minute (Topsoe, 2022). Stamicarbon is considering new plants operating in the 50%-100% load range. All of these reports of course are protected by patents and no details on the actual process control strategies employed are available in the open literature.
chinese_fragments: 关于制氮空气分离过程的柔性运行，已有充分的文献记载（Klein et al., 2021）。质子交换膜（PEM）电解槽同样具有较宽的操作范围（额定处理能力的 5% - 100%）和较短的响应时间（Boynuegri and Tekgun, 2023; Mucci et al., 2023），因此能够实现柔性制氢。然而，传统工厂中的 Haber-Bosch 过程在稳态下运行，从额定处理能力向下降负荷的能力有限（Fahr et al., 2023）。受绿氨生产柔性运行需求的推动，主要合成氨技术公司近期公布了借助过程控制进展，在宽操作范围内实现动态运行的能力。Casale 报告称，合成氨工厂能够以低至额定处理能力 10% 的负荷运行（Ostuni and Zardi, 2016），并可在约 30 分钟的时间尺度内完成 10-100% 范围内的负荷调整。Topsoe 的动态合成氨技术具有 10-100% 的负荷范围，负荷变化速率至少为每分钟 3%（Topsoe, 2022）。Stamicarbon 正在考虑建设在 50%-100% 负荷范围内运行的新工厂。当然，这些报道涉及的技术均受到专利保护，公开文献中没有实际所用过程控制策略的详细信息。

english_fragments: Several design and scheduling studies incorporating flexible ammonia production have appeared (Palys and Daoutidis, 2023b,a). In Wu et al. (2024), capacity design and scheduling optimization of an electricity-hydrogen-ammonia system were investigated, in which various operating ranges and load adjustment rates of the ammonia synthesis system were evaluated. In Wen and Aziz (2022), a flexible operation strategy was adopted for a renewable multi-generation system with green hydrogen and ammonia production to satisfy the electricity needs of multiple cities; the dynamics of the ammonia synthesis process however was not explicitly considered. A study on the robust design and dynamic optimization of a flexible power-to-ammonia plant simulated the dynamic behavior of the Haber-Bosch process in Verleysen et al. (2023), yet a detailed control strategy was not discussed. Some older studies have focused on the regulatory control of the ammonia synthesis system (Araújo and Skogestad, 2008; Zhang et al., 2010) using linear controllers, without considering variations in the load. Without proper control during load changes, a reactor bed can overheat, deactivate the catalyst, or cool excessively, halting the reaction (Rosbo et al., 2023). In Rosbo et al. (2023), a PID control structure was used to stabilize the ammonia synthesis system for limited flexibility on the operation, with the reactor load allowed to vary by up to 10%.
chinese_fragments: 已有若干设计与调度研究纳入了柔性合成氨生产（Palys and Daoutidis, 2023b,a）。Wu et al.（2024）研究了电-氢-氨系统的容量设计与调度优化，并评估了合成氨系统的不同操作范围和负荷调节速率。Wen and Aziz（2022）针对包含绿氢和氨生产的可再生能源多联产系统采用了柔性运行策略，以满足多个城市的用电需求；但该研究并未显式考虑合成氨过程的动态特性。Verleysen et al.（2023）关于柔性电制氨工厂鲁棒设计与动态优化的研究模拟了 Haber-Bosch 过程的动态行为，但没有讨论详细的控制策略。一些较早的研究采用线性控制器，关注合成氨系统的调节控制（Araújo and Skogestad, 2008; Zhang et al., 2010），而未考虑负荷变化。如果在负荷变化时缺乏适当控制，反应器床层可能过热并导致催化剂失活，也可能过度冷却而使反应停止（Rosbo et al., 2023）。Rosbo et al.（2023）采用 PID 控制结构，在有限的运行灵活性下稳定合成氨系统，允许反应器负荷最多变化 10%。

english_fragments: Evidently, very few studies have addressed the process control of the ammonia synthesis process under dynamic operation over a wide operating range. In this paper, we design and implement a plant-wide nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) scheme for the ammonia synthesis process with a flexible load that varies between 50% and 100% of the reactor’s nominal capacity. Our goal is to demonstrate the feasibility of efficient dynamic operation of the Haber-Bosch process for ammonia production and to motivate further research on this problem given its importance in the context of green ammonia production. The rest of this paper is structured as follows: the description and modeling of the process are discussed in Section 2; the control problem is stated in Section 3; the NMPC formulation is provided in Section 4; simulation results are presented and discussed in Section 5; and concluding remarks are provided in Section 6.
chinese_fragments: 显然，针对宽操作范围动态运行下合成氨过程的过程控制，相关研究仍然很少。本文针对负荷可在反应器额定处理能力的 50% 至 100% 之间灵活变化的合成氨过程，设计并实现了一种全厂非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）方案。我们的目标是证明 Haber-Bosch 合成氨过程高效动态运行的可行性，并鉴于这一问题对绿氨生产的重要性，推动对该问题的进一步研究。本文其余部分安排如下：第 2 节讨论过程描述与建模；第 3 节陈述控制问题；第 4 节给出 NMPC 的数学表述；第 5 节展示并讨论仿真结果；第 6 节给出结论。

Design parameters for the reactor beds and the flash tank, and the nominal operating conditions adopted from Rosbo et al. (2023); Zhang et al. (2010) are shown in Table 1.
chinese_fragments: 图 1 所示为 Haber-Bosch 过程的流程图；该过程包括三个绝热活塞流反应器床层、两台换热器（HE-1、HE-2）、两台压缩机（C1、C2）和一个闪蒸罐。反应器床层与闪蒸罐的设计参数，以及取自 Rosbo et al.（2023）和 Zhang et al.（2010）的标称操作条件，列于表 1。

english_fragments: The raw feed stream consisting of H₂ and N₂ (Stream 0) is first mixed with the recycle stream from the flash tank (Stream 6). After it is compressed to 200 bar by C2 and the temperature rises to 523 K, the total feed stream is split into four streams (Streams 1-4). Flowrates of Streams 1-4 are determined by the split ratios of the respective valves. Stream 1 is pre-heated by Stream 5 in the heat exchanger HE-1, then mixed with Stream 2, and fed to the first reactor bed. Interstage cooling is provided by direct mixing of cold synthesis gas (quenching stream) with the outlet stream from the previous reactor bed: the outlet stream of the first reactor bed is cooled by mixing with Stream 3 before fed to the second reactor bed, and the outlet stream from the second reactor bed is mixed with stream 4 before fed to the third reactor. Stream 5, as the output from the third reactor bed, is compressed to 196 bar by C1 and cooled to 313 K by heat exchanger HE-2 before fed to the flash tank, where ammonia is condensed and separated. The catalyst used in the reactor beds is metallic iron on Fe₃O₄, and its properties, adopted from Morud and Skogestad (1998), are shown in Table 2.
chinese_fragments: 由 H₂ 和 N₂ 组成的新鲜进料流股（流股 0）首先与来自闪蒸罐的循环流股（流股 6）混合。混合后的总进料流股经 C2 压缩至 200 bar、温度升至 523 K 后，被分为四股（流股 1-4）。流股 1-4 的流量由各自阀门的分流比决定。流股 1 在换热器 HE-1 中由流股 5 预热，随后与流股 2 混合，并送入第一反应器床层。级间冷却通过将冷合成气（急冷流股）与上一反应器床层的出口流股直接混合来实现：第一反应器床层的出口流股与流股 3 混合冷却后进入第二反应器床层；第二反应器床层的出口流股与流股 4 混合后进入第三反应器。流股 5 为第三反应器床层的出口流股，经 C1 压缩至 196 bar，并由换热器 HE-2 冷却至 313 K 后进入闪蒸罐，氨在罐内冷凝并分离。反应器床层使用的催化剂为 Fe₃O₄ 上的金属铁，其性质取自 Morud and Skogestad（1998），见表 2。

english_fragments: The flash separation is assumed to be an isothermal process, in which ammonia is condensed at 313 K and 196 bar. The ammonia concentration in the liquid phase varies with the operating pressure: higher pressure leads to lower ammonia concentration, due to more hydrogen and nitrogen dissolved in the product (Araújo and Skogestad, 2008; Zhang et al., 2010; Lin et al., 2020). Given the separation pressure and temperature adopted in this work, the nominal ammonia concentration is 97.65 mol%. The nominal liquid volume is set to 30% of the total volume of the flash tank, with an acceptable range between 25% and 40% of the total volume. The production rate can be manipulated by adjusting the valve at the bottom of the flash tank. Another valve is set at the outlet of the vapor phase to regulate the recycle flowrate. Also, a purge valve is deployed to regulate the tank pressure. According to the nominal flash pressure (196 bar) and the feed pressure of the reactor (200 bar), the operating pressure range is set to be between 190 and 200 bar.
chinese_fragments: 假定闪蒸分离为等温过程，氨在 313 K 和 196 bar 下冷凝。液相中的氨浓度随操作压力变化：压力越高，溶解在产品中的氢气和氮气越多，因此氨浓度越低（Araújo and Skogestad, 2008; Zhang et al., 2010; Lin et al., 2020）。在本文采用的分离压力和温度下，标称氨浓度为 97.65 mol%。标称液体体积设为闪蒸罐总体积的 30%，可接受范围为总体积的 25% 至 40%。可通过调节闪蒸罐底部的阀门来操纵生产速率。在气相出口另设一个阀门，以调节循环流量。此外，还设置了放空阀以调节罐内压力。根据标称闪蒸压力（196 bar）和反应器进料压力（200 bar），操作压力范围设为 190 至 200 bar。

english_fragments: In the modeling of the synthesis loop, some assumptions and simplifications are made. Compressors are not modeled; it is assumed that the streams fed to C1 and C2 can always be pressurized to the desired pressure. Also, the modeling of heat exchanger HE-2 is not considered. It is assumed that the cold utility used in HE-2 is sufficient to cool the hot stream to the nominal temperature (313 K).

The prediction time horizon is set to be 180 seconds, and the Backward Euler method is used to discretize the model in time with a 10-second discretization step, based on which $f=180/10=18$. The resulting nonlinear program (NLP) that consists of 7638 variables among which 1134 are differential state variables and the remainder are algebraic varibales, 7525 equality constraints, and 2488 inequality constraints is solved by IPOPT (Wächter and Biegler, 2006). The variables are initialized with values from the previous prediction result or from the steady-state optimization. Note that when an optimal solution to the prediction problem is not obtained, the control inputs returned by the solver are still adopted.

english_fragments: The temperature profiles at the inlet and outlet of each reactor bed are shown in Figures 3 and 4 as solid lines, whereas the dashed lines represent the corresponding set points. All temperatures are well maintained within a safe operating range (i.e., between 600 K and 900 K), ensuring that the reactor beds neither cool down excessively nor experience catalyst deactivation. Optimal temperatures (set points) vary depending on the feed flowrate, with the maximum increase in a single step being approximately 45 K. The controller is able to bring the temperatures close to the corresponding set points smoothly within approximately 10 minutes following a step change in the feed flowrate, though small offsets exist. The offsets are most likely due to the different discretizations of the ODEs when solving the prediction NLP problem and simulating the plant. Comparing across the three scenarios with different disturbance levels, slight temperature fluctuations are observed when the standard deviation increases from 0 to $\sigma_2$, and the fluctuations are significantly larger when the standard deviation is set to $\sigma_3$. Despite these fluctuations, the inlet and outlet temperatures are still controlled near their set points in all the cases.

english_fragments: Figure 5 shows the profile of the pressure in the separator, along with the recycle flowrate and purge flowrate that have significant influence on the pressure. The pressure is well maintained within the desired operating range (190-200 bar) and is controlled near the nominal operating pressure of 196 bar. The pressure increases when the feed flowrate ramps up, and it drops when the feed flowrate ramps down. It takes up to 40 minutes for the pressure to reach steady state after a step change in the reactor load, which is slower than the temperature transitions. This is due to the relatively strict constraints set for the ramping of the recycle flowrate to avoid drastic pressure and temperature fluctuations. It is also evident that the purge flowrate increases to reduce the pressure in the separator when it gets close to the upper bound, and is maintained near zero when the plant is at steady state. When the disturbances increase, larger fluctuations in the pressure are observed, resulting in more frequent adjustments of the recycle flowrate to stabilize the pressure. Still, the offset of the pressure is not completely eliminated.
chinese_fragments: 图 5 显示了分离器内压力的变化曲线，以及对该压力有显著影响的循环流量和放空流量。压力保持在期望的操作范围（190-200 bar）内，并被控制在标称操作压力 196 bar 附近。进料流量上升时，压力增大；进料流量下降时，压力降低。反应器负荷发生阶跃变化后，压力达到稳态最长需要 40 分钟，慢于温度的过渡过程。这是因为，为避免剧烈的压力和温度波动，对循环流量的变化设置了较严格的约束。还可以明显看出，当分离器内压力接近上界时，放空流量增大，以降低压力；工厂处于稳态时，放空流量则保持在零附近。当扰动增大时，压力波动也更大，因此需要更频繁地调整循环流量，以稳定压力。不过，压力偏差仍未完全消除。

english_fragments: The ammonia production rate and the ammonia concentration in the product stream are shown in Figure 6. It is interesting to note that even though the production rate is not directly controlled, by controlling other state variables such as temperatures in the reactor beds and the pressure of the separator, the actual production rate stays very close to the optimal production rate obtained from the steady-state optimization. No fluctuation of the production rate is observed when the disturbance increases, as it is directly manipulated. When the feed flowrate changes, the transition between production rates takes up to 20 minutes. The transitions are smooth and the production rate profile is steady after the transitions, due to the penalties on the ramping of the production rate. The mole fraction of ammonia in the product varies slightly around the nominal concentration 0.9765, and is in the range of 0.9760 – 0.9768, depending on the separation pressure. The quality of the product, i.e. the ammonia concentration, is acceptable considering the reference values of 0.96 and 0.99 reported in Zhang et al. (2010) and Lin et al. (2020), respectively. Minor fluctuations appear in the ammonia concentration when the disturbance increases. Transitions of the ammonia concentration between steady states are slower than that of the production rate, due to the slow pressure changes in the flash tank.

The PID control structure is shown in Figure 7, where PI controllers are deployed to track feed temperatures of reactor beds and the pressure in the separator, while a P controller is used to regulate liquid volume in the flash tank. The purge valve is opened if the actual vapor output flowrate of the separator can not be increased to the value specified by the controller in time, due to the ramping constraints applied to the recycle valve. The PID scheme is implemented in Simulink 2024a, where controller parameters are tuned via the built-in tuning functionality. Details of the controlled variables with the corrsponding manipulated inputs and controller parameters are shown in Table 7.

Thus, the time periods for each feed flowrate (except the first one) are extended from 1 hour to 1.5 hour, as shown in Table 8. Other parameters such as equipment sizes, catalyst properties, and initial temperatures and pressures are consistent with those described in Section 2. To make a fair comparison, the NMPC scheme is also tested with the same feed flowrate profile. Disturbances in the reaction rates are not considered.

english_fragments: The comparison of feed temperatures of the reactor beds is shown in Figure 8. The PI controllers manage to track the set points with zero offsets; however, significant oscillations that can be detrimental to the catalysts are observed, especially after a large step increase of the feed flowrate at the 330th minute. In contrast, the NMPC results show no or little temperature oscillations despite the small offsets, and the temperatures reach steady state at least 3 times faster than the those obtained from the PID control scheme. Separation pressures in the NMPC result and the PID control result are shown in Figure 9. The PI controller tracks the reference pressure in 60 - 80 minutes after a large step change in the feed flowrate, which is significantly longer than the time required by the NMPC. The production flowrate and ammonia concentration in the product are shown in Figure 10. Both control schemes adjust the production flowrate as a manipulated variable which stays at the optimal value after a steady state is reached. However, in the PID control, more fluctuations are observed in the production flowrate profile and it takes longer to have a steady product output after a 43% feed flowrate increase at the 330th minute. The ammonia purity in the product is acceptable in both cases, while in the NMPC it exhibits less variance due to faster tracking of the separation pressure. Overall, the NMPC scheme outperforms the PID control scheme in terms of the temperature/pressure tracking speed and the transition smoothness, though minor offsets (less than 1% of the set points) may exist.

english_fragments: In this work, an NMPC scheme for the control of a flexible ammonia production system is proposed and tested. A feed schedule in which the feed flowrate varies between 50% and 100% of the nominal value is assumed for a 5-hour time horizon. The simulations demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed control scheme. Results show that all the controlled variables are maintained in a safe operating range and tracked near the corresponding set points, with small offsets. The transitions of reactor temperatures take around 10 minutes, and it takes around 40 minutes for the pressure in the flash tank to reach a steady state for a large step change in the feed flowrate. When normally distributed disturbances are introduced to the reaction rate, minor fluctuations are observed in both the profiles of the reactor temperature and the separation pressure. The production rate, on the other hand, is not affected by these disturbances as it is directly manipulated, and it stays close to the optimal values dictated by the steady-state optimization. The ammonia concentration in the product is between 97.60% and 97.68%, which is close to the nominal value of 97.65%. Compared to a PID control scheme, the NMPC tracks the temperatures and the pressure significantly faster, and a smoother transition in the production flowrate is also observed.
chinese_fragments: 本研究提出并测试了一种用于柔性合成氨生产系统控制的 NMPC 方案。假定了一个 5 小时时域内的进料调度，其中进料流量在标称值的 50% 至 100% 之间变化。仿真证明了所提出控制方案的可行性。结果表明，所有被控变量均维持在安全操作范围内，并跟踪至相应设定值附近，但存在小偏差。反应器温度的过渡约需 10 分钟；当进料流量发生较大阶跃变化时，闪蒸罐内压力达到稳态约需 40 分钟。在反应速率中引入正态分布扰动后，反应器温度与分离压力曲线均出现轻微波动。另一方面，由于生产速率被直接操纵，它不受这些扰动影响，并保持在稳态优化确定的最优值附近。产品中的氨浓度介于 97.60% 与 97.68% 之间，接近标称值 97.65%。与 PID 控制方案相比，NMPC 对温度和压力的跟踪明显更快，产品流量的切换也更加平稳。

english_fragments: In all, the proposed NMPC strategy is demonstrated to work well for the considered flexible ammonia synthesis process, under the assumption that all variables are measured accurately and are noise-free. Future research efforts will focus on addressing the control problem under realistic measurements of the state variables and addressing the control of the process over a wider operating range (e.g. 10%-100% reactor load variation).
chinese_fragments: 总体而言，在假定所有变量均得到准确测量且不含噪声的条件下，所提出的 NMPC 策略已被证明能有效控制所研究的柔性合成氨过程。未来研究将重点解决在状态变量的实际测量条件下的控制问题，并研究更宽操作范围内的过程控制（例如反应器负荷在 10%-100% 之间变化）。
